Definition: Integration of CRVS data (births, deaths, marriages) into data exchange for real-time verification and service eligibility
Comments: Civil registration system is "essentially paper based with no consolidated database, decentralized" per World Bank 2023 diagnostic. Digitalization of CR services underway with ANATS, with efforts to integrate with health systems. A 2019 CRVS systems report listed Chad's national ID records as electronic but CRVS as paper-based. Under active development.

Definition: Extent to which the national digital identity system is integrated with the data exchange for identity verification and authentication
Comments: In 2020, Chad introduced SIGPTS (integrated identity management system) managed by ANATS, providing unique National Identification Number (NIN) through National Biometric Registration Program (RNBP). However, two separate systems exist for civil registration (paper-based) and national ID card, requiring reforms. Integration with data exchange platform lacking. World Bank notes "existing government recognized legal identification systems require reforms to serve as foundation for digital service delivery.

Definition: Integration of health records, patient registration, immunization data, and health insurance into data exchange
Comments: Digital clinical decision support system (TRICC) piloted in refugee/rural health contexts with NGO support. Cloud server subscription required (government infrastructure insufficient for local server). Integration of CR services with health systems mentioned in WB project. No national health information system integrated with government data exchange.

Definition: Integration with national payment systems for government-to-person (G2P), government-to-business (G2B) transactions via data exchange
Comments: Digital payments infrastructure limited: "a shared government digital payments infrastructure is not available and the GoC makes limited use of digital means of payment." Some mobile money for community teachers and cash transfers. e-Tax and e-Tax modules launched from 2022 onward. Limited interoperability among mobile wallet providers.

Definition: Integration of tax administration and revenue collection systems data into the exchange platform
Comments: SIGFiP (Integrated Public Finance Management System), eTax application, and ASYCUDA World (customs) are operational back-office systems. e-Tax platform launched July 2022. e-registration and new e-Tax modules launched March and May 2023. However, these systems are siloed and not integrated through a common interoperability framework.
